title: MZ looking for a skeleton head!

posts.author: Wariosbiggestfan
posts.body: I wont bore you with the details of why, but one of the characters in my RPG's party is a skeleton, but RPG maker's default generator bits do not abide such things, so im either looking for one to use, or requesting someone to make one, im still very new to pixel art and editing so im not confident I could make it from scratch. im using a different battler sprite so I only really need a walking sprite and a portrait. I dont want to be picky, but if someone could just make it an accessory I think that would be easiest? one of my other characters wears a helmet so I just used a helmet accessory and hid the ears behind it, and hiding the neck behind a cloak or clothing option would be easy on my end, in terms of styling, given the lack of any similar pieces its pretty open, just nothing too simplified or overexaggerated(I.E mumbo from banjo kazooie is not what im looking for). also hello forums this is my first post here!

posts.author: JGreene
posts.body:
Welcome! Here's a link to some skeleton resources (character, face, SV battler). Just follow the links in the thread there. They were made for MV, but MZ uses the same format.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/threads/chalkdust-resources.47335/

posts.author: Wariosbiggestfan
posts.body: much appreciated my friend, these should work a treat!
